{{Top|leg}}
The '''Drellis Syndicate''' was a criminal syndicate operating during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was suspected to have helped engineer the escape of the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Brahle Logris]] from [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Tamazall/Legends|Tamazall]].<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>
